title: Normalize cron governance imports without path surgery

acceptance.criterion: Keep governance module identity canonical without a facade or fallback import
acceptance.evidence: deployment_saga imports deployment_plan by its canonical absolute package name, and the clean-path test asserts all three exact module names.
